name: convert-digital-backend-challenge
description: Backend coding challenge submission. Option 1 (API rate limiter) lives in packages/rate-limiter; the workspace is laid out so Option 2 (WebSocket chat server) can be added as a sibling package.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run openapi:check && npm run asyncapi:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.build: npm run build -w @challenge/rate-limiter && npm run build -w @challenge/chat-server
